==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Curses]])
:Curses + 1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:Halves skill recharge time of Curses [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Forget Me Not" and "Master of My Domain".
